qualifications: SAML authentication, linked identity, credential authorization and actual token/key validity remain distinct lifecycle objects.
SCIM enterprise-managed user endpoints do not provision enterprise accounts; org SCIM and EMU implementation scopes remain distinct.
GHES JIT IdP removal alone does not block tokens/SSH; actual suspension not performed.
Public-resource SAML exemptions and outside-collaborator exceptions remain source-local, not broad access grants.
Recovery codes are enterprise versus account-specific as scoped, single use/consecutive and24hours where described.
IdP admin capability, license consumption or trial links are not project authorization.
GraphQL orgowner/Appinstall access differs from enterpriseownertoken and enterpriseApp exclusion.
MixedIdP errors, previewbranches, ratelimits, clock/sessionthresholds and conditionalaudit events preserved.
All550records includingmetadata appear exactly once; not whole-corpus reconciliation.
